citations.claim: Body 0 is to the right of wall 0 (wall spans x 11.62-11.88) one step before violation
First violating step: body 0 centre has jumped to left of wall 0, crossing through it between steps 4 and 5 despite 61 substeps
Body 0 x-velocity after heavy-body impact is ~-75 m/s, giving ~1.47 m per-step displacement far larger than 0.258 m wall thickness

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0195 to 0.002 (only field changed) so per-step displacement no longer exceeds wall thickness; same 5 steps now pass.

explanation: Light body 0 (m=1) is struck by heavy fast body 1 (m=15) gaining vx~-75 m/s. Per-step displacement ~1.47 m greatly exceeds thin wall width 0.258 m. Despite 61 substeps in steps 4-5, wall collision is effectively only resolved at step boundaries (or substep CCD absent), so centre jumps from x=12.93 (right of wall) to x=11.46 (left of wall) between steps 4 and 5, tunneling through wall 0. Smaller dt removes failure, confirming per-step displacement vs wall thickness as cause.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 4 and 5

vision_note: The red circle moves leftward toward the thin vertical wall from the right across steps 2 to 4 while the blue circle remains to its right. At step 5 the red circle is suddenly intersecting the wall on its left side, having jumped clean through the barrier instead of bouncing off.
